skills.name: systematic-debugging
skills.description: Use when encountering any bug, test failure, or unexpected behavior, before proposing fixes
skills.whenToUse: 遇到 bug、测试失败或意外行为时，先系统排查再修

skills.name: test-driven-development
skills.description: Use when implementing any feature or bugfix, before writing implementation code
skills.whenToUse: 实现功能或修 bug 前，先写测试驱动开发

skills.name: brainstorming
skills.description: You MUST use this before any creative work - creating features, building components, adding functionality, or modifying behavior. Explores user intent, requirements and design before implementation.
skills.whenToUse: 任何创造性工作（新功能/组件/改行为）之前，先梳理意图与设计

skills.name: code-review-and-quality
skills.description: Conducts multi-axis code review. Use before merging any change. Use when reviewing code written by yourself, another agent, or a human. Use when you need to assess code quality across multiple dimensions before it enters the main branch.
skills.whenToUse: 合并前对代码做多维质量评审

skills.name: planning-and-task-breakdown
skills.description: Breaks work into ordered tasks. Use when you have a spec or clear requirements and need to break work into implementable tasks. Use when a task feels too large to start, when you need to estimate scope, or when parallel work is possible.
skills.whenToUse: 把大任务拆成有序可执行的小任务
